name: TFHE Code Generation Benchmark
description: The first benchmark for evaluating LLM inference and agentic optimization in Fully Homomorphic Encryption (TFHE) code generation, focusing on logic gates and ReLU activation, assessing error rates, compilability, and structural similarity.
reputation: A very specialized benchmark introduced for TFHE code generation, with limited adoption outside the homomorphic encryption and secure ML research communities.
notes: Evaluates LLMs on TFHE code generation with agentic optimizations like RAG and few-shot prompting; highlights limitations of off-the-shelf models.
